tagline: Give the agent a goal, not a list of clicks.
dedication: Dedicated to 90's Moms and the young generation.
design_archetype: High-Trust Command Center (Hybrid SaaS Workspace + Tactile Human Warmth)
context_type: hybrid_fullstack (Agentic AI SaaS app / Three-pane workspace dashboard)

layout_architecture.container: h-screen w-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background text-foreground
layout_architecture.top_navbar: h-14 border-b border-border/80 px-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-card/60 backdrop-blur-xl z-30 shrink-0

left_pane.name: Agent Chat & Command Console
left_pane.role: Natural language prompt input, model selector (Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Gemini 3.1 Pro), file attachments, start/stop agent, reasoning summary stream, tool cards, file artifact downloads.

center_pane.name: Live Computer & Screen Preview
center_pane.role: Real-time browser screenshot view, interactive viewport overlay, action bounding boxes, DOM highlighter, URL bar display, view tab switcher (Screen / Terminal Log / DOM Inspector / Canvas).

right_pane.name: Task Execution & Safety Control Panel
right_pane.role: Current micro-action status, progress bar, tool checklist execution tree, Human Approval Dialog (Allow Once / Allow Always / Reject), task timeline, history log, audit trail.

model_brain_selector.component: Shadcn Select or Custom Toggle Pills with model badge badges

agent_loop_visualization.component: Interactive horizontal/vertical step indicator with glowing status pulses (emerald = active, amber = waiting approval, blue = thinking)

human_approval_system.styling: High-contrast modal/card banner with amber warning glow and clear test-ids

authentication_system.modal_or_page: Email + Password login modal with account switcher (Mom Mode / Power User / Developer mode)

micro_interactions.agent_pulse: animate-pulse on active agent thinking dots
micro_interactions.streaming_text: Smooth character typing effect or fade-in text blocks
micro_interactions.live_indicator: Glowing emerald dot with ping animation for live screen view
micro_interactions.approval_dialog: Framer motion scale-up spring animation with backdrop blur

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, state badges MUST contain data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='prompt-input', data-testid='start-agent-button', data-testid='allow-once-button').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: WCAG AA / APCA compliant high-contrast text against dark slate and soft gray backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep code modular: create individual pane components (LeftChatPane.js, CenterPreviewPane.js, RightTaskPane.js) under src/components/.
3. Support seamless Light and Dark mode toggling with smooth transition.
4. Ensure realistic simulated streaming of agent responses, browser screenshots, and tool execution logs.
5. Highlight the dedication prominently in footer/about modal: 'Dedicated to 90's Moms and the young generation.'
6. Include model selection between Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro.
7. Include all specified data-testid attributes on buttons, inputs, tabs, and status cards.
